create_preprocessor: create a Preprocessor instance with normalization parameters and optional GPU device for feature preprocessing
run_forward_preprocessing: run the forward pass to preprocess input tensors with presence byte masks through the Preprocessor
get_input_prototype: get sample input prototype tensors showing expected shape and dtype for the Preprocessor
review_preprocess_continuous: review the CONTINUOUS feature preprocessing method that normalizes input using mean and standard deviation
review_preprocess_boxcox: review the BOXCOX feature preprocessing method that applies power transformation before continuous normalization
